notes.title: Solarpunk x Kickstarer - now live 🎉

Feel free to give us a retweet on Twitter even if Solarpunk is totally new to you 💙

Party on, everyone! 🎊🎈

notes.title: New Project - Solarpunk - Coming to Kickstarter soon
notes.content:
Hey Hourglass fans, 
We are excited to announce our upcoming game called Solarpunk. It´s a beautiful first person survival game set in a world of floating islands, where you can use advanced solar technology to craft a self-sufficient ecosystem. You will use sunlight, wind and water to create an energy system and automate your processes like gathering resources or watering your plants.

We also have a short Teaser for Solarpunk:

[previewyoutube=7Zhfg938Bt8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Key-Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer: Play alone or in co-op mode with your friends.
[*] Building: Gather ressources and build your own home in the sky.
[*] Farming: Grow plants to secure your food supplies.
[*] Crafting: Craft technical gadgets and automate your processes.
[*] Energy: Use sunlight, wind and water and create an energy system for your gadgets.
[*] Airship: Build your own airship and explore distant islands in the sky.
[/list]
 
If you want to support us then please follow us on:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyberwave/solarpunk-survival-craft-game-in-world-of-floating-island][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36421824/2a1ed142e0b770004184b13437d7c6b640c1deb5.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805110/Solarpunk/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36421824/00259e5eda80374bc7f1c66066c7303caf8209d2.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/solarpunk_game?lang=de][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36421824/9e24a6f2bdda0577540726467695c35e0dc7a543.png[/img][/url]


A new partner
We're also excited to announce that we've partnered with [url=https://twitter.com/rokaplayHQ]rokaplay[/url]. We believe that this partnership will allow us to reach more players and create an even better experience for everyone.
Thank you for your support and enthusiasm for Solarpunk, and we can't wait to launch our next Kickstarter campaign, hopefully with your support!

Your team @ [url=https://linktr.ee/cyberwavegames]Cyberwave[/url]

notes.title: Hourglass Gameplay (Pre-Recorded)
notes.content: In Hourglass you can create a time-clone of yourself to solve challenging puzzles. You will play as Aywa, a young adventurer who is traveling to Egypt to find her missing father - an archeologist, who never returned from his latest expedition.
